name: Free University of Berlin
summary: Large research university founded in 1948 in south-west Berlin; its one English-taught bachelor's is North American Studies.

handoff.label: North American Studies, FU's one English bachelor's

ib.text: Apply to FU and request a VPD from uni-assist, which checks your IB against the KMK rule and converts it to a German grade. Restricted programmes rank most places on FU's own selection points.

apply.via: FU application portal, plus a VPD from uni-assist

programmes.name: North American Studies
programmes.about: The US and Canada studied in English through four of six disciplines (history, culture, literature, politics, sociology, economics) at FU's John F. Kennedy Institute, with a compulsory semester abroad in year three.
programmes.ib: English at C1: an IB counts only from an English-speaking country, else IELTS 7.0 (6.0 in writing), TOEFL iBT 5.0 or FU's own test. No German needed.
programmes.selectionNote: 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published. About 60% of places on FU points (grade up to 50, plus relevant North America experience), 20% on grade alone, 20% by waiting time.

notes: The 2027 dates are not out yet (FU publishes them each March); for winter 2026/27, restricted bachelor's took applications from 1 June to 15 July 2026.
In winter 2025/26 North American Studies had 62 places and 173 applications: the grade quota closed at a German 1.8, but the larger selection quota admitted down to 22 of FU's points.
A semester abroad in the third year, at a North American university or an approved partner, is compulsory.
